articles.author: Gerry Shih, Suheir Hashimeh, Lior Soroka, Rachel Chason
articles.title: European diplomats attacked in West Bank a day after beating of Post photographer - The Washington Post
articles.description: Two alleged attacks by settlers have sparked outrage among some Israelis. Mike Huckabee, U.S. ambassador to Israel, condemned the attack on photographer Heidi Levine as a “despicable act of terror carried out by masked cowards.”
articles.content: JERUSALEM A group of European diplomats was assaulted in the West Bank on Saturday, allegedly by Israeli settlers, a day after an attack by settlers that seriously injured Washington Post photographe… [+56 chars]
